# ex: avoid keyword prevents rewriting in avoided function
ex {
	var x int
	avoid F
	x + 1 -> x + 2
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F() int { return 1 + 1 }
func G() int { return 1 + 1 }
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 package m

 func F() int { return 1 + 1 }
-func G() int { return 1 + 1 }
+func G() int { return 1 + 2 }
